preconditions.description: Input N is a positive integer between 1 and 20 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output list contains exactly 2^(N-1) valid N-bit binary strings.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == N for s in NBitBinary(N))
postconditions.description: Each string in the output has exactly N characters.

postconditions.expression: all(all(s[i] in '01' for i in range(N)) for s in NBitBinary(N))
postconditions.description: Each string in the output consists only of '0' and '1' characters.

postconditions.expression: all(any(s == '1' * N for s in NBitBinary(N)) if N == 1 else True)
postconditions.description: For N=1, the output contains only '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(any(s == '1' * N for s in NBitBinary(N)) if N == 2 else True)
postconditions.description: For N=2, the output contains '11' and '10'.

postconditions.expression: all(any(s == '1' * N for s in NBitBinary(N)) if N == 3 else True)
postconditions.description: For N=3, the output contains '111', '110', and '101'.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(NBitBinary(N), reverse=True) == NBitBinary(N) for N in range(1, 21))
postconditions.description: The output list is sorted in decreasing lexicographical order.

postconditions.expression: all(any(all(sum(s[:i+1].count('1') >= s[:i+1].count('0')) for i in range(N)) for s in NBitBinary(N)) if N > 0 else True)
postconditions.description: For every string in the output, every prefix of length i+1 (0 ≤ i < N) has at least as many '1's as '0's.
